from fastapi import APIRouter as Router, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy.orm import mapped_column as column
from .models import Item as Model
from .. import settings
from plugins import *
import package.module as mod, os
router = Router(prefix="/items")
__all__ = ["Model", "endpoint"]
class Record(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(default="")
    id: int = column(primary_key=True)
@router.get("/", dependencies=[Depends(auth)])
def endpoint(item: Model, service=Depends(load_service)):
    return service.run(item)
